statement: Griffy introduces a raw unedited "Dungeon Talk" format as filler content because guides take over two weeks to make.
Start Bubo dungeon run with vials: gas then syringe then spirit then auspicious aura then sizzling skull; two gray RNG items to start.
Each gray RNG item gives plus one percent drop chance.
Drop chance is the most important stat in this dungeon because RNG items must drop to get the cauldron for the boss.
Flurbo bonuses: 30% more drops from mobs/bosses (not that relevant); enhancers instead of equipment 25% more; RNG prices scale 15% slower; greener RNG 25% likelier.
Royal trait gives 100% chance to start each dungeon with a purple RNG item of choice; take Horn of the Fool; he calls it one of the best traits.
The level 50 trait does not work as it says right now.
Card setup used: 105 dungeon damage; 65% MP regen; 30 dungeon money; 10 block chance; 35 boost speed; 100 RNG item rarity.
Top-left and bottom-right card chips also work for party dungeons so they can increase those cards' values.
Level crit chance first and do not take Stone of the Bulwark right away; build crit chance first.
He usually clears the right side first as soon as possible.
Everything is down to level 50 due to party dungeons.
In group play buy accessories early and start getting drop chance from enhancers right away to get Eye of the Frog going; solo you do not need to.
Griffy apologizes for no video this week; scripting and making videos alone is time consuming.
Take Rabbit Spa for drop chance; blood vials are always strong; anti-ice pick needed only three because all RNG items are maxed.
Getting an RNG voucher early is very good.
He usually takes Horn of the Fool when going for the second Frog boss and wants it done as soon as possible.
Per gray RNG item gives one percent drop chance.
Do a full clear then clear the left pack.
Do not take Single Cut right away; build up food first because it is huge.
With enough drop chance you do not need to clear the right side; get Frog eye from cleared areas which is faster.
Hold RNG voucher without buying RNG items yet to keep building up in case a second voucher drops.
Matter crystal is huge for any caster because you need mana regen.
Boss skull is always strong.
Casters need less mana than Maestro or Barbarian but it still changes the game if you lack it.
Use red vials for maximum damage followed by syringe.
Buying more RNG items builds drop rate; decide when to buy based on skull count.
Dead books are massive; with three dead books take Horn of the Fool.
Batteries and Sugar Rush are always strong; Sugar Rush is huge especially with super soda.
In world 1 or 2 party dungeons take one or two liar scraps but no more or it is overkill.
Usually you do not want Auto Loot on there.
Griffy talks about busy schedule and weekly uploads and videos getting more extensive with more worlds.
Bubo is very strong with lots of active abilities; building crit chance and big damage.
Spend all money on RNG items until a threshold when everything becomes very expensive.
With 33 skulls could summon Frog boss already; full clear is possible with enough damage.
Power of Horn of the Fool is too strong for pumping out damage; run is doable even without strong cards.
Syringe is one of the strongest Bubo abilities for single-target boss damage; keep on your bar.
Jenny sphere makes the run an easy win.
At about level 40 to 50 you really start to pop off and can do almost anything.
World 1 is easiest; World 3 is more hectic; World 2 is not hard but long; world 1 timer about 11 minutes.
World 2 has no timer but would take minimum 30 to 40 minutes.
He is looking for a video editor and asks people to DM on Discord or Twitter.
Build is lots of crit chance with plenty of mana plus base damage and drop chance.
You only need that much drop chance for World 1; elsewhere it is almost unnecessary and not very good in World 2 and 3.
Triad of the Manifying is really good on wizard mage general or bubo; good on Squire; pretty good but not extreme on Maestro.
He plans a Stone of the Bulwark build video to test if it is doable; he finds it bad so far.
Sugar Rush still S tier; super soda handy ice picks sharp eyes are super good; tax ledger sneaky cap all right.
Tortoiseshell not too bad and boss call is a dream.
Party dungeon has an overflow mechanic where damage beyond a cap counts as only 999000 on the other player's side; Lava should fix it.
Jenny sphere gives more gray RNG items.
Prioritize as much drop rate as possible and you will get your first solo Frog 4 kill.
Could have done run with Triad of the Manifying or Stone of the Bulwark but would have struggled hard.
He does not take keychains because they are kind of garbage.
Run result: crit damage multiplier 10.95x; drop rarity 2.64 thanks to gray RNG perk; crit chance 165.
There is no mega crit in dungeons so that much crit chance is nonsense.
Thanks for nearly 5000 subscribers; next video is an Island video next week.
